Package com.skyblockexp.ezframework.proxy.event

Interface ProxyPacketEvent

public interface ProxyPacketEvent
Base type for all proxy packet events fired through a ProxyEventManager.

Each event carries the EzContext that was attached to the original inbound packet (containing the player name and source server), as well as a cancellation flag that listeners can set to signal that subsequent processing should be suppressed.

Implement this interface to define a custom proxy packet event: 


 public class PlayerLoginPacketEvent implements ProxyPacketEvent {

     private final EzContext context;
     private final String playerName;
     private boolean cancelled;

     public PlayerLoginPacketEvent(EzContext context, String playerName) {
         this.context = context;
         this.playerName = playerName;
     }

     public String getPlayerName() { return playerName; }

     @Override public EzContext getContext()          { return context; }
     @Override public boolean   isCancelled()         { return cancelled; }
     @Override public void      setCancelled(boolean c) { this.cancelled = c; }
 }

  • Method Details

    • getContext

      EzContext getContext()
      The context that accompanied the original inbound packet.

      The context contains the triggering player name and the source server name as known by the proxy transport.

      Returns:
      the EzContext; never null

    • isCancelled

      boolean isCancelled()
      Returns whether this event has been cancelled by a prior listener.

      Handlers registered with ignoreCancelled = true are skipped when this returns true. Handlers at priority EventPriority.MONITOR always execute regardless of cancellation state.

      Returns:
      true if the event is cancelled

    • setCancelled

      void setCancelled(boolean cancel)
      Sets the cancellation state of this event.
      Parameters:
      cancel - true to cancel the event
